messages.subject: bioc-teaching call March 13, 3-4pm CET
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

a reminder about the bioc-teaching call on Monday, March 13, 3-4pm CET (please check the time, as we are in the period where some parts of the world are in daylight saving time and others are not).
I made an attempt at formulating some questions and key points for the bioc-rnaseq lesson (which we discussed in our planning meeting two weeks ago). I added them to the bioc-rnaseq planning document (https://docs.google.com/document/d/1YDKTeDX3z9W6eGbWaTQAUb_hs0iUC9saGvkO_Po5tfA/edit?usp=sharing) to make it easier to get an overview and discuss - please feel free to add yours there too, or edit these.

Minutes/agenda: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1s2QMk5XA-uhBVprAO3ZDk1Yfv1cnUWLp9zdvYq9Feu4/edit?usp=sharing
Jitsi link: https://meet.jit.si/BioconductorTeaching

See you on Monday,
Charlotte & Laurent
